      rw [hdigits_to_num]

  have he := step e f h.2

    have eqn : (∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ)^i.1 + digits_to_num d)) =
        digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
